engagement_background.objective: FreshEdge engaged Treya Partners to conduct strategic sourcing across indirect (non-COGS) spend and select logistics categories in order to capture measurable cost savings and deliver at least $0.6M in guaranteed annual EBITDA improvement.
engagement_background.scope_summary: The project initially covered 7+ indirect categories (e.g., packaging & corrugate, pallets, utilities, waste management, fuel, LTL/FTL freight, temp labor, benefits, insurance) representing roughly $25-33 M in addressable spend, with customer-directed tableware, contracted telecom, leased forklifts and other low-value areas explicitly excluded or later removed from scope.
constraints_challenges: Highly fragmented spend spread across more than 20 business units (Get Fresh, Piazza, Indianapolis Fruit, Sirna & Sons, etc.) operating on separate systems and processes
Significant data cleansing effort required – multiple AP/GL exports, inconsistent vendor names, and large deltas between kickoff and refreshed spend files
Existing long-term supplier agreements and equipment leases (e.g., 3-year telecom contract, forklift leases) limit near-term addressable spend
Customer-directed or brand-specified suppliers (e.g., tableware) constrain supplier switching despite potential savings
Some categories showed limited savings (<5-10%) causing stakeholder reluctance to pursue changes

procurement_environment.data_availability: AP/GL spend exports from Produce Pro and other systems for each business unit; no unified spend platform or contract repository.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Multiple vendor naming conventions required manual de-duplication; differing time frames across files (Jan-Dec 2022 vs Jul 2023-Jun 2024) caused large variances; direct vs indirect spend intermingled and had to be re-mapped.
